LanguageData.DMS_Drone_Erima.description: A work drone controlled and deployed from a base station. Four long, narrow tracks let it climb trunks to prune branches and move through fields without crushing crops, while two delicate manipulator arms handle harvesting and sowing. Commonly seen in unmanned agricultural facilities and urban parks tending greenery.
LanguageData.DMS_Drone_Erima.tools.pruning_arm.label: pruning arm
